invocation_metadata.response_schema_scope: Prompt guidance and strict local validation only; no provider enforcement claim

findings.detail: The input size limit is enforced by reading up to MAX_BYTES + 1 (131073 bytes) and checking length before decoding UTF-8. Empty input returns an empty string without raising an error.

Validation uses object_pairs_hook=unique_object and parse_constant=reject_constant with json.loads, strictly rejecting duplicate keys and nonfinite numeric constants. Strict type checks and regex validation ensure graph node and edge compliance.

Topological ordering uses a min-heap over in-degree 0 nodes, ensuring lexicographically smallest available node selection. Layers are computed in independent sorted rounds from copied in-degrees without mutating graph structures.

Whole-batch processing buffers and validates all requests before writing to stdout. Any validation or parsing failure directs stderr output exactly to 'topo-plan: invalid input\n' and exits with status 2.

result.reason: The implementation in topo_plan.py, along with README.md and criteria.md, strictly adheres to the functional contract, correctly handles NDJSON batch atomicity, edge limits, duplicate edge consolidation, and lexicographic topological ordering versus layered rounds.
